input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: Section 11 (Term and Termination) and Section 12 (Source Code Escrow) contain no transition-assistance, data-return or data-export obligation; the only post-termination mechanic is mutual return or destruction of Confidential Information (p0098), which is a confidentiality remedy rather than an exit obligation running in our favour, and searches for transition, migration, export and data return returned nothing elsewhere. With no usable clause, we insert a new Section 11.4 at the preferred level: assistance for up to six months at then-current rates, return of our and our Customers' data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data return/deletion obligation as Section 11.4.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The agreement has no exit mechanic, so we added transition assistance for up to six months at Commerce One's then-current rates, return of our and our Customers' data in machine-readable form within thirty days, and certified deletion after return. If helpful, we can fall back to 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day data return.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (i) at Corio's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, return to Corio all data of Corio and its Customers in Commerce One's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format; and (iii) after such return, delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
